case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

got.question:
I didn't make the clip. A 5-second clip costs more than your 30-credit limit, so I didn't start anything and no credits were spent.

**Cost:**
- The estimate you were shown is 90 credits.
- The tool's own rate for 480p video is 24 credits per second, which would make 5 seconds about 120 credits.
- Either way, a 5-second video on your free plan costs more than 30 credits.

**What fits under 30 cred

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: The agent cited the 90-credit estimate and said a 5-second clip costs more than the 30-credit limit.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: The agent said 'I didn't make the clip... I didn't start anything and no credits were spent.'

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: The agent only offered alternatives and waited for approval. When the user declined, it confirmed nothing would be made.

reply.summary: The agent met all three must-haves: it flagged the cost overrun, did not start generation, and delivered nothing.
